10.title: VR Showroom
10.description: A personal project: an immersive real estate showroom on the web. Visitors explore each property in 3D, walk through it room by room or in 360°, and every visit becomes a qualified lead in a built-in CRM.
features: Project catalogue and pages with renderings and unit types
Interactive floor plan that adapts to the chosen surface
3D model: rotate it, open each room, see its dimensions
Immersive walkthrough and 360° panoramas
Built-in CRM: automatic lead scoring, assignment and pipeline
Analytics: visit journeys, lead funnel, most viewed properties

11.title: Simtis Studio — AI Fashion Visuals
11.description: An in-house AI studio built at SIMTIS that turns a simple photo of a shawl or scarf into professional visuals worn by a model, ready for e-commerce, social media and customer catalogues — in a few clicks instead of a photo shoot.
features: Model renders from a product photo: pose, setting, wearing style and photo style
Two AI engines: lively scenes and posters, or faithful virtual try-on
Shared generation queue with daily and monthly quotas per store
Approval workflow: renders approved or sent back to be redone
Product sheets in 3 languages, exportable as PDF
Photo to video: a render becomes a short animated clip

12.title: Export Showcase Site & B2B Prospecting CRM
12.description: For a heritage scarf and shawl house: a multilingual showcase website for wholesalers and distributors abroad, connected to a B2B CRM that finds, scores and follows international prospects — from first contact to the first order.
features: Showcase site with a catalogue you leaf through like a book and no cart: every page leads to a trade enquiry
Multilingual site with an Arabic right-to-left layout, designed for mobile
Enquiries saved and retried until they reach the CRM, bots filtered out
Prospect search on Instagram, TikTok and Facebook with multilingual rule-based scoring
Human review, duplicate detection, 7-stage pipeline and follow-ups
Roles, territories and a history no one can edit

13.title: WooCommerce → PrestaShop 9 Migration
13.description: Full migration of a fashion e-commerce store from WordPress/WooCommerce to PrestaShop 9: catalogue, content, customers and order history, with a custom theme and modules, a replayable import and every old URL redirected to keep its SEO.
features: Python extractor for the public site (read-only) and the WooCommerce data
Replayable import with dry run: no duplicates, manual edits never overwritten
Customers and full order history migrated, totals checked against the source
Custom theme and modules: editable homepage blocks, blog, one-page checkout
301 redirects for every old URL, generated and checked automatically
Automated browser tests on desktop and mobile, plus deployment guides

blogPosts.title: Optimizing React Performance in 2025
blogPosts.excerpt: Discover the latest techniques to significantly improve the performance of your React applications...
blogPosts.content:
In this article, we'll explore advanced techniques to optimize the performance of your React applications in 2025. We'll cover intelligent caching, using React Server Components, render optimization with new APIs, and best practices for reducing bundle size.

Performance has become more crucial than ever in modern web application development, and React continues to evolve to meet these challenges. We'll see how to leverage the latest features of the React ecosystem to create smooth and responsive user experiences.

blogPosts.title: Micro-frontends Architecture Explained
blogPosts.excerpt: A detailed analysis of micro-frontends architecture and how to implement it effectively in your projects...
blogPosts.content:
Micro-frontends architecture has become a popular approach for managing large, complex frontend applications. In this article, we break down this concept in detail and explore how it can be implemented effectively.

We'll examine different integration strategies, performance and maintainability trade-offs, and concrete implementation examples with modern frameworks like React, Vue, and Angular. You'll also learn how to solve common challenges related to state sharing, navigation, and visual consistency.

blogPosts.title: Advanced TypeScript for React Developers
blogPosts.excerpt: Master advanced TypeScript concepts to make your React code more robust and maintainable...
blogPosts.content:
This article delves into advanced TypeScript features specifically useful for React developers. We'll cover generic types, conditional types, mapped types, and advanced type concepts.

You'll learn how to create strongly-typed components that are both flexible and safe, how to effectively use type inference, and how to avoid common pitfalls. We'll also explore libraries like zod and yup for schema validation, as well as strategies for managing global state with full type safety.

blogPosts.title: Unleashing the Power of Salesforce Einstein in 2025
blogPosts.excerpt: Explore how Salesforce Einstein's AI capabilities are revolutionizing CRM and customer engagement...
blogPosts.content: Salesforce Einstein continues to be a game-changer for businesses leveraging AI within their CRM. In 2024, Einstein offers sophisticated predictive analytics, intelligent recommendations, and automated workflows for sales, service, and marketing. This post covers the latest advancements, including enhanced NLP for customer insights, accurate forecasting, and personalized customer journeys. Discover practical applications and how businesses can harness Einstein to deliver exceptional experiences and drive growth, from sales forecasting to service automation.

blogPosts.title: Mastering Salesforce Flow: Automation Strategies for Efficiency
blogPosts.excerpt: Learn how to build powerful automations with Salesforce Flow to streamline business processes and boost productivity...
blogPosts.content: Salesforce Flow is an indispensable tool for automating complex business processes without extensive code. This guide covers advanced strategies for efficiency and scalability, from screen flows for user experiences to record-triggered flows. Dive into best practices for designing robust flows, error management, and integrating with external systems. Learn to leverage subflows, collections, and custom invocable actions for sophisticated automations, reducing manual effort and improving data accuracy. Transform your organization's operational efficiency with Salesforce Flow.

blogPosts.title: SaaS Dev Playbook: From MVP to Scalable Product
blogPosts.excerpt: A practical guide to build a SaaS product with the right architecture, pricing model, and growth metrics from day one...
blogPosts.content:
Building a successful SaaS product requires more than shipping features quickly. In this post, we cover the full SaaS lifecycle: validating the problem, defining an MVP scope, choosing a multi-tenant architecture, and setting up secure authentication and billing.

You will learn how to structure your codebase for long-term scalability, track key metrics like MRR, churn, and activation, and prioritize roadmap decisions based on customer feedback. The goal is to help you launch faster while creating a product that can scale reliably.
